dispatches_per_controlled_attempt: Zero for context, attachment, marker, scope, or pre-send cancellation rejection. One accepted-helper invocation for a valid attempt, including later caller-release rejection.
recognition: Read active ContextVar and agent namespace only. Resolve current_context for controlled attachments or the exact reserved provider marker.
cancellation_flag: Existing _interrupt_requested. Missing means False. Only exact bool values are supported.
cancellation_boundaries: After accepted-helper return and before caller release
cancellation_exception: InterruptedError: Agent interrupted during API call
exceptions: Mark the captured context denied without marker conversion. Use invalidate_controlled_context and re-raise all exceptions, including process-control exceptions.
post_callback_cancellation: Preserve actual send count and accepted internal invocation. Do not release caller result.
dependency: Exact immutable local hermes-content-policy 0.1.0 wheel, installed without index or dependencies.
direct_api_call: Unchanged. No separate controlled entrypoint qualification.
attachment_contract: Require the same current registered NativeContentContext and captured sealed adapter. Require the exact True bound marker before native scope validation.
validation: Use current_context and validate_native_scope. Check attachment identity before and after validation and after each cancellation-flag read.
